items.title: SQLite DatabaseBusy under full-workspace parallel test runs
items.detail: `cargo test --workspace` at default job parallelism can fail crates/driver-install/tests/coordinator.rs::restore_end_failure_after_mutation_requires_recovery_and_never_completes with SQLITE_BUSY when several test binaries run simultaneously on a loaded machine. The test passes in isolation and the full suite is clean with `--jobs 2`. The product service opens its journal database from a single process; this is test-scheduling contention only.

items.title: 17 pre-existing svelte-check warnings retained unchanged
items.detail: Warnings (unused CSS selectors, a11y hints) present in the Phase 19 tree are preserved byte-for-byte rather than churned, per byte-minimal diff discipline.

items.title: StartOptimization intentionally returns Forbidden pending consent broker
items.detail: Plan creation and status retrieval are fully wired; direct execution requires single-use consent tokens issued by the desktop review flow. The router refuses execution without that handshake instead of silently applying changes — the safe default.
